ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $BC=4$, a circle $\odot A$ with center A and radius 2 is tangent to $BC$ at point D, intersects $AB$ at point E and $AC$ at point F. Point P is a point on $\odot A$, and $\angle EPF = 40^\circ$. What is the area of the shaded region in the figure?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\[ \text{\bf Solution:} \text{ As shown in the figure, connect AD.} \]
\[ \because \angle EPF=40^\circ, \]
\[ \therefore \angle EAF=2\angle EPF=80^\circ, \]
\[ \therefore S_{\text{sector} EAF}=\frac{80\pi \times AE^{2}}{360}=\frac{80\pi \times 2^{2}}{360}=\frac{8\pi }{9}. \]
\[ \because \text{BC is the tangent of } \odot O \text{ with the tangent point at D}, \]
\[ \therefore AD\perp BC, AD=2, \]
\[ \therefore S_{\triangle ABC}=\frac{1}{2}AD\cdot BC=\frac{1}{2}\times 2\times 4=4. \]
\[ \because S_{\text{shaded}}=S_{\triangle ABC}-S_{\text{sector} EAF}, \]
\[ \therefore S_{\text{shaded}}=4-\frac{8\pi }{9}. \]
\[ \text{Therefore, the answer is: } \boxed{4-\frac{8\pi }{9}}. \]
